# Enforcement map

Which check or tool enforces each rule, and why a reviewer enforces the rest.
Where a check covers part of a rule, the row names the check and the note says
what is left to review. A rule marked **review** has no mechanical form yet, or
cannot have one; the note says which.

The tables below are generated by `node scripts/generate-guidelines.mjs`: the
ids come from the rule files, what enforces each from the checks'
`scripts/check-*.rules.json` and from `tool-enforcement.json`, and the notes
from `enforcement-notes.json` ([guidelines.md](../guides/guidelines.md)). Edit
those, never the tables.

## Required checks

Branch protection on `main` requires four checks: `Repo checks`, `Lint`,
`Type-check` and `Unit tests`. Every `scripts/check-*.mjs` runs in `Repo
checks`; SwiftLint, swift-format and oxlint run in `Lint`; `swift build` and the
site's `tsc -b` in `Type-check`; `swift test` and the `node:test` suites in
`Unit tests`. `make verify` runs the same checks locally
([verify.md](../guides/verify.md)).

## Who reviews

Foretype has one maintainer and no review bot, so protection requires checks,
not approvals. "Review" means the maintainer reading the PR against these
rules, after the author ran `/deslop` on the diff. A waiver that would need a
second approver (a budget or baseline that grows) is reported, not blocked,
until a second approver exists.

## Outside tools

| Tool | Runs in | Rules it enforces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| swiftlint | Lint: `swiftlint --strict` with `.swiftlint.yml`; the PostToolUse hook on each edited Swift file | `file_length` (CODE-18), `function_body_length` (CODE-20), `type_body_length` (CODE-21), `cyclomatic_complexity` (CODE-11), `todo` (CODE-15), `force_unwrapping` (SWIFT-1), `force_try` (SWIFT-1), `force_cast` (SWIFT-1), `implicitly_unwrapped_optional` (SWIFT-1), `fatal_error_message` (SWIFT-4), `no_print` (OBS-1), `no_pasteboard` (PRIV-2) |
| swift-format | Lint: `swift format lint --strict` with `.swift-format`; the PostToolUse hook formats each edited Swift file | `FileScopedDeclarationPrivacy` (SWIFT-7), `AlwaysUseLowerCamelCase` (SWIFT-8), `TypeNamesShouldBeCapitalized` (SWIFT-8), `format` (SWIFT-9) |
| swiftc | Type-check and Unit tests: `swift build` with the settings in `app/Package.swift` | `Swift 6 language mode` (CONC-1), `ExistentialAny` (SWIFT-6), `target dependencies` (MOD-2) |
| privacy-check | Repo checks and app CI: `app/scripts/privacy-check.sh` | `network API outside ModelStore.swift` (PRIV-1), `clipboard API` (PRIV-2) |
| tsc | Type-check: `npm run build` in `site/` (`tsc -b`) | `strict` (CODE-9), `noUnusedLocals` (CODE-4) |
| commitlint | the commit-msg hook and CI, with the scope list in `CONTRIBUTING.md` | `type-enum, scope-enum` (AGENTS-9) |
| gitleaks | the pre-commit hook and CI, over the tree and every PR commit | `default rules` (SEC-8) |
